en_note: Machine translation by Claude (my reading), not on Pesna.org and not checked by a native speaker. Treat it as a study aid.
translator_notes: Humorous song of a boy too young to marry. 'Клиса' I take as a children's game (my reading); 'се настури' I render 'got ready' (my reading, unsure).

lines.cyr: Свадба ќе си праве, Чачко ми Рожденски,
lines.lat: Svadba ḱe si prave, Čačko mi Roždenski,
lines.en: Chachko from Rozhden is holding a wedding,

lines.cyr: дете ќе си жене за мома Клиновка,
lines.lat: dete ḱe si žene za moma Klinovka,
lines.en: he is marrying off his child to the girl from Klinovo,

lines.cyr: Чачко се настури долу в Кавадарци,
lines.lat: Čačko se nasturi dolu v Kavadarci,
lines.en: Chachko got ready down in Kavadarci,

lines.cyr: пазар ќе си праве, сина ќе си жене,
lines.lat: pazar ḱe si prave, sina ḱe si žene,
lines.en: he will go shopping, he is marrying off his son,
Chachko did the shopping, Chachko bought a lot,

lines.cyr: па си дошол дома, дете да облече,
lines.lat: pa si došol doma, dete da obleče,
lines.en: and came home to dress the child,

lines.cyr: Вамо дете, тамо, нигде дете нема,
lines.lat: Vamo dete, tamo, nigde dete nema,
lines.en: Here is the child, there, the child is nowhere,

lines.cyr: оно си играе клиса со децата,
lines.lat: ono si igrae klisa so decata,
lines.en: he is playing 'klisa' with the children,

lines.cyr: - Тате мили тате, неќум да ме жениш,
lines.lat: - Tate mili tate, neḱum da me ženiš,
lines.en: - Dear father, I do not want you to marry me off,

lines.cyr: жена е голема, она ќе ме тепа,
lines.lat: žena e golema, ona ḱe me tepa,
lines.en: the wife is grown up, she will beat me,
